text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for Narita Taishin's<n>debut race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: However, she seems very uneasy.
choice_data_list: Want to do some breathing exercises with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Bug off. I'm not scared or anything.<n>Got it?

text_block_list.name: Race Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! Please make your way<n>to the
paddock!
Oh... Right, okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, see ya later.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she leaves, I can see her legs are<n>trembling
ever so slightly.
choice_data_list: (What can I do to encourage her?)
(What can I do to encourage her?)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Spectators crowd about, eager to<n>catch a glimpse of
the Umamusume in<n>the paddock who may one day
become legends in their own right.

Spectators crowd about, eager to<n>catch a glimpse
of the Umamusume in<n>the paddock who may one
day<n>become legends in their own right.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I spot Narita Taishin standing among<n>her fellow
racers.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up with that one over<n>there? She's
pretty darn tiny...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Does she even stand a chance with<n>that stature?
Seems like she could get<n>blown away.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I-Is she going to be okay? I hope she<n>doesn't get
hurt...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch.

No one seems to expect much from<n>her. She hangs
her head down amid<n>the murmuring voices whirling
around<n>her.

No one seems to expect much from<n>her. She
hangs her head down amid<n>the murmuring voices
whirling around<n>her.

No one can deny that her lack of<n>height is a
disadvantage when it<n>comes to racing.

You're too short! "You're too frail!"<n>"You're not cut
out to be a racer!"

You're too short! "You're too frail!"<n>"You're not
cut out to be a racer!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All that junk—I'm sick and tired of<n>hearing it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Okay?! I don't care what people say!<n>I'm gonna
stay right on the turf! I'll<n>show all you whiny
morons!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll show you exactly where I should<n>be!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be laughing when I tell you to<n>shove it from
the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is stronger and more<n>determined to
win than anyone, and<n>she has the ability to make all
her<n>declarations come true.

And I'll be laughing when I tell you to<n>shove it
from the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is stronger and more<n>determined to
win than anyone, and<n>she has the ability to make
all her<n>declarations come true.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I know this better than<n>anyone.
What?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm shouting before I realize what<n>I'm doing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, stop yelling! Seriously!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are we doing? We should<n>be cheering
her on. It's her debut,<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Go get 'em, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: We're behind you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Look what that idiot started!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
First, I'm going to win, then I'm<n>kicking that doofus
to the other side<n>of the world!

First, I'm going to win, then I'm<n>kicking that
doofus to the other side<n>of the world!
